home.aboutTitle: A student team that learns underwater
home.aboutFallback: Founded at the Turkish-German University, TAUV is a student team that builds unmanned underwater vehicles end to end — from design to manufacturing. With our mechanical, electronics, software and organisation teams we put a new vehicle in the water every season and represent our university at national and international competitions.
